title: Zenfold micro-rail schematic switcher and cost telemetry proto
creator: Riley Patel
description: Design a compact, performance-minded workspace switcher pattern ("Zenfold") that combines an accordion-style micro-rail with an integrated cost telemetry tile. Goal: reduce lateral chrome, make workspace switching faster for customers who toggle across 20–200 workspaces, and surface per-route cost trends and rollout state without requiring a full dashboard hop.
acceptance_criteria: Accordion micro-rail prototype implemented in Figma with states: closed, expanded, pinned, and search-focused
Cost telemetry tile shows 7-day cost trend and per-model cost breakdown for the active workspace (mock data)
Prototype demonstrates virtualization approach for long workspace lists (perf-friendly hints) and accessible keyboard flow
Design spec includes rollout affordances: canary flag, environment tag, and quick-fallback action
PM and Eng have signed off on trade-offs and a handoff doc for front-end implementation
design_notes: We prioritized a condensed micro-rail over a full sidebar to free vertical space for dashboards. Trade-offs: less room for long labels vs. faster context switches. Decided on a progressive disclosure model — show compact chips by default, expand on hover or via keyboard. Cost tile will be a lightweight sparkline + tokenized breakdown; heavier cost drilldowns link to the Console cost view. For long workspace lists (>50) we recommend virtualization + server-side search to avoid client-side render costs. Consider accessibility: preserve ARIA roles and focus traps during expand/collapse.
comments: 2026-02-12 — Riley: Initial exploration sketches added. Two candidate layouts: stacked chips (fast scan) vs. compact accordion (saves vertical space). Added cost tile variants: sparkline-only vs. sparkline + mini-legend.
2026-02-18 — Marta: Consolidated the chip typography and reduced iconography to a single state to reduce noise. Flagged need for keyboard-only flows for accessibility review.

2026-02-25 — Eng (Kunal Sharma): Concern: rendering 200 workspaces in the rail will be expensive on low-end devices. Suggest virtualization + server-side paging. Also asked about measured payload sizes for tokenized cost breakdowns.
2026-03-02 — Riley: Implemented virtualization notes in the spec and added an optional prefetch for workspace metadata. Updated prototype to include search-focused expanded state.
2026-03-05 — PM (Ivy Chen): PM alignment call — requested canary affordance and per-workspace rollout tag. Added quick-fallback CTA that triggers the console rollout flow (links to rollout manager).

2026-03-08 — Design review: Aisha approved visual weight and motion. Leah requested stronger affordance for the pinned workspace and suggested moving the cost tile to the right edge in expanded mode for visual separation.
2026-03-10 — Marta: Updated spec with final annotations and handoff checklist. Ready for dev grooming on 2026-03-12.
implementation_notes: Front-end: expose a 'microRail' component with states: compact, expanded, pinned. Props: workspaces[], activeWorkspaceId, onSwitch(), costSummary{sparkline, breakdown}
Performance: use windowing/virtualization for workspace list; server-side search API for >100 workspaces
Telemetry: emit 'workspace.switch' event with routing context and 'costTile.open' when cost tile is expanded
Rollouts: hook quick-fallback CTA to rollout-1click endpoint; surface canary status as badge
next_steps: Ship prototype A/B behind feature flag for 10% of traffic
